ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Daycare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of daycare-related fraud in Minnesota and identify potential schemes
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records review
questions: What is the extent of daycare-related fraud in Minnesota?
How are daycare owners exploiting the system?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and highlight the need for increased oversight in the daycare system. I recommend analyzing public records and conducting interviews with daycare owners and regulators to identify potential schemes.
